semantics.silence: removes existing material before explicit transition events are authored
semantics.harmonic_anticipation: explicit scale-degree chord, role and voicing intervals authored by Agent
semantics.pickup: explicit scale degrees/rhythm/octave authored by Agent
semantics.bass_approach: deterministic operation into existing destination bass target
semantics.register_preparation: explicit semitone shift in a bounded destination window before E3 allocation
semantics.rhythm_fill: explicit drum events relative to the section boundary

semantics.allowed_overlaps: protected during budget arbitration; not a blanket ban on unlisted pairs
semantics.phrase_gap_only: decorative event must not overlap authored primary phrase body
semantics.silence_roles: hard event gate after arrangement/transition generation
